summary: Make adoption defaults portable and owned

delivery.outcome: New adopters receive a stack-neutral governance baseline whose managed launchers and Goal configuration have complete ownership
nonGoals: No removal of Docker support from schemas, profiles or validator
No package payload, dependency, version or release change
No downstream mutation, push, pull request, merge or publication

architecture.decision: Keep the baseline stack-neutral and let targets opt into Docker while assigning every managed launcher to governance ownership
interfaceChanges: The default target manifest no longer mandates the Docker stack
architecture.rollback: Targets that need the old behavior opt into Docker in their extendable manifest; reverting restores the mandatory default

validation.evidence: Schema-valid default has no Docker required file, false docker.required and no declared stacks
Regression requires root wrappers, runtime script and Goal config in governance ownership

commands: all commands from the Linux CI test job
validation.evidence: Every supported standard test remains green
Only the default manifest, regression, documentation and ticket evidence change
